microtheory.name: climate_atmospheric
microtheory.definition: Atmospheric science + climate. Structure + composition of atmosphere. Weather vs climate. Greenhouse effect. Radiative forcing. Anthropogenic climate change. Climate models (GCMs). Paleoclimate. ENSO, NAO, PDO oscillations. IPCC + scientific consensus. Substrate analogue: discipline of long-term dynamical-system behavior under forcing — the planetary control system humans depend on.

concepts.name: atmosphere_structure
concepts.definition: Troposphere (0-12 km) → stratosphere (12-50 km) → mesosphere → thermosphere. Vertical temperature structure differs. Most weather in troposphere.

concepts.name: atmospheric_composition
concepts.definition: N2 78%, O2 21%, Ar 0.9%, CO2 0.042%, water vapor variable. Trace gases (CH4, N2O, O3) climatically critical.

concepts.name: ozone_layer
concepts.definition: Stratospheric O3 absorbs UV. Antarctic hole from CFCs. Montreal Protocol 1987 success.

concepts.name: tropopause
concepts.definition: Boundary between troposphere + stratosphere. Temperature minimum (~-60°C). Jets fly near.

concepts.name: weather_vs_climate
concepts.definition: Weather = short-term atmospheric conditions; climate = long-term statistical patterns (~30 years standard). 'Climate is what you expect; weather is what you get.'

concepts.name: climate_system
concepts.definition: Atmosphere + ocean + cryosphere + biosphere + land surface. Coupled. Feedbacks + nonlinearities.

concepts.name: radiative_balance
concepts.definition: Earth receives ~340 W/m2 from Sun, radiates equal IR back. Imbalance → temperature change.

concepts.name: albedo
concepts.definition: Reflectivity. Snow/ice high (~0.8), ocean low (~0.06), Earth average ~0.30. Feedback: warming reduces ice → reduces albedo → more warming.

concepts.name: greenhouse_effect
concepts.definition: Atmosphere absorbs IR emitted by surface + re-emits some downward. Without it: ~-18°C surface. With: ~+15°C. Tyndall 1859, Arrhenius 1896.

concepts.name: greenhouse_gas
concepts.definition: Absorb infrared. Water vapor (main) + CO2 + CH4 + N2O + CFCs + O3. GWP (global warming potential) compares.

concepts.name: co2_atmospheric
concepts.definition: Pre-industrial 280 ppm. 2024 ~420 ppm. Industrial era fossil fuels + land use. Highest in 800k years (ice cores).

concepts.name: methane_atmospheric
concepts.definition: Pre-industrial 700 ppb. Now ~1900 ppb. Agriculture + fossil + landfill + wetlands. 80× CO2 GWP over 20 yr.

concepts.name: radiative_forcing
concepts.definition: Change in net irradiance from forcing agent (e.g., CO2 doubling ≈ 3.7 W/m2). Drives equilibrium temperature change.

concepts.name: climate_sensitivity
concepts.definition: Equilibrium warming for CO2 doubling. ~3°C best estimate, 2.5-4°C likely. Equilibrium vs transient.

concepts.name: feedback_climate
concepts.definition: Self-amplifying or self-dampening response. Water vapor positive (warm → more H2O → more warming). Cloud uncertain. Ice-albedo positive.

concepts.name: water_vapor_feedback
concepts.definition: Warming increases atmospheric water vapor (Clausius-Clapeyron); H2O is GHG. ~2× amplifies CO2 forcing.

concepts.name: cloud_feedback
concepts.definition: Largest uncertainty. High thin clouds warm; low thick clouds cool. Net likely positive.

concepts.name: ice_albedo_feedback
concepts.definition: Warming melts ice → exposes dark surface → more absorption → more warming. Polar amplification.

concepts.name: carbon_cycle_feedback
concepts.definition: Warming → permafrost thaw + ocean CO2 outgassing + reduced sinks → more CO2 → more warming.

concepts.name: climate_models
concepts.definition: General Circulation Models (GCMs). Discretise atmosphere + ocean + land. Solve fluid + radiation + chemistry. CMIP coordinated.

concepts.name: ipcc
concepts.definition: Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change. Assesses science. AR6 2021-23 most recent. Consensus + uncertainty quantified.

concepts.name: scenario_rcp_ssp
concepts.definition: Future emissions trajectories. RCPs (radiative concentration pathways) + SSPs (shared socioeconomic pathways). Combine: SSP1-1.9 ambitious mitigation; SSP5-8.5 high emissions.

concepts.name: global_warming
concepts.definition: Increasing global mean surface temperature. ~1.2°C since preindustrial through 2024. Driven mainly by CO2.

concepts.name: anthropogenic_climate_change
concepts.definition: Human-caused. Attributable through fingerprint matching + paleoclimate. >97% scientific consensus.

concepts.name: paris_agreement
concepts.definition: 2015. Limit warming well below 2°C, pursue 1.5°C. Nationally determined contributions. First universal climate treaty.

concepts.name: impacts_climate
concepts.definition: Sea level rise, heat extremes, drought + flooding patterns, ecosystem shifts, ocean acidification, biodiversity loss.

concepts.name: tipping_points_climate
concepts.definition: Thresholds beyond which large irreversible changes occur. AMOC slowdown, Amazon dieback, Arctic methane, ice sheets.

concepts.name: ocean_acidification
concepts.definition: CO2 dissolves in ocean → carbonic acid → lower pH. ~0.1 unit decrease since preindustrial. Coral + shellfish stressed.

concepts.name: enso
concepts.definition: El Niño-Southern Oscillation. Pacific tropical air-sea coupled mode. El Niño (warm) + La Niña (cool). Multi-year cycle. Global impacts.

concepts.name: nao
concepts.definition: North Atlantic Oscillation. Sea-level-pressure see-saw. Drives winter European weather.

concepts.name: pdo_amo
concepts.definition: Pacific + Atlantic Decadal/Multidecadal Oscillations. Internal climate variability. Confound short-term trend detection.

concepts.name: paleoclimate
concepts.definition: Past climate reconstructed from proxies. Ice cores (800 kyr direct CO2 + isotopes), corals, tree rings, sediments. Shows current change unprecedented in rate.

concepts.name: milankovitch_cycles
concepts.definition: Orbital eccentricity + obliquity + precession (100/41/23 kyr). Drive ice age cycles. Insolation distribution.

concepts.name: ice_age
concepts.definition: Glacial-interglacial cycles last ~2.6 Myr. Last glacial maximum ~20 kya. We are in interglacial (Holocene).

concepts.name: mitigation
concepts.definition: Reduce emissions. Renewables, efficiency, electrification, land use, CCS. Required for stabilising temperature.

concepts.name: adaptation_climate
concepts.definition: Adjust to impacts. Sea walls, drought-resistant crops, heat-resilient infrastructure. Both adaptation + mitigation needed.

concepts.name: carbon_capture_storage
concepts.definition: CCS. Capture CO2 from emissions or air; store geologically. Required at scale for net-zero targets. Costs declining slowly.

rules.name: greenhouse_effect_warms_planet_habitably
rules.head: Jabberwock examines Earth's temperature
rules.body: without atmospheric greenhouse effect, Earth surface would be ~-18°C uninhabitable. With it, ~+15°C. Tyndall + Arrhenius. Substrate's atmospheric-control system.

rules.name: climate_sensitivity_governs_response
rules.head: Jabberwock predicts warming from emissions
rules.body: doubling CO2 → ~3°C warming at equilibrium (range 2.5-4°C). Determines policy stringency required.

rules.name: feedbacks_amplify_initial_forcing
rules.head: Jabberwock analyses climate response
rules.body: water vapor + ice-albedo + cloud feedbacks amplify direct CO2 forcing by factor ~2-3. Without feedbacks the response would be small.

rules.name: tipping_points_create_irreversibility
rules.head: Jabberwock considers risk
rules.body: thresholds (AMOC, ice sheets, Amazon, permafrost) exist beyond which changes commit + cannot be reversed on human timescales. Asymmetric risk.

rules.name: paleoclimate_calibrates_current_change
rules.head: Jabberwock contextualises modern change
rules.body: ice cores show 800 kyr CO2 between 180-300 ppm. Current 420 ppm + rate of change unprecedented. Confirms anthropogenic attribution.
